landing.title: Garage Talk

landing.description: The ultimate platform for automotive mechanics. Get instant diagnostic help from Gearhead Agent, watch expert tutorials, and collaborate in real-time chat rooms.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything You Need to Diagnose and Repair
landing.featuresDescription: Garage Talk combines video learning, Gearhead Agent diagnostics, and community support in one powerful platform.
landing.threeSteps: Get started in three simple steps
landing.step1Description: Use Gearhead Agent to describe engine issues in plain English like "Engine knocking at idle on Chevy 350"
landing.step2Description: Get matched with relevant video tutorials and step-by-step repair guides
landing.step3Description: Connect with other mechanics in live chat rooms for real-time troubleshooting
landing.pricingDescription: Start free and upgrade as you grow. All paid plans include profit sharing.
landing.viewAllPlanDetails: View all plan details and features
landing.ctaDescription: Join thousands of mechanics who are already using Garage Talk to diagnose issues faster and share their expertise.
